tooltip.fastgrowth.speed: Halves the Accelerator's growth interval and the Harvester's harvest interval (max %s per machine).
tooltip.fastgrowth.range: Increases the affected area, in the Accelerator and the Harvester (max %s per machine).
tooltip.fastgrowth.energy_cost: Increases energy use by %s FE/t per unit.
tooltip.fastgrowth.energy_cost_range: Increases energy use by %s FE/t per unit in the Accelerator and %s FE/t in the Harvester.
tooltip.fastgrowth.machine_energy: Needs energy (FE): %s to %s FE/t, depending on upgrades.
tooltip.fastgrowth.inhibitor: Turns off the machine's growth particles, reducing lag.
tooltip.fastgrowth.inhibitor_scope: Works in any accelerator (max 1 per machine).
tooltip.fastgrowth.harvester: Harvests mature plants without destroying the planting. Without the Magnet, items drop on the ground.
tooltip.fastgrowth.magnet: Stores what the Harvester collects in its own inventory instead of dropping it.
tooltip.fastgrowth.magnet_scope: Only works in the Plant Harvester (max 1 per machine). Hoppers and pipes can empty the inventory.
tooltip.fastgrowth.how_to_install: Right-click the machine to install directly, or put it in its interface.
message.fastgrowth.upgrade_max: This machine already has the maximum level of that upgrade.
message.fastgrowth.wrong_tier: This upgrade doesn't fit this machine.
message.fastgrowth.harvester_wrong_upgra: The Harvester only uses range and speed upgrades and the Magnet.
message.fastgrowth.inhibitor_already: This machine already has a Particle Inhibitor.
message.fastgrowth.magnet_installed: Magnet installed: the harvest goes to the machine's inventory.
message.fastgrowth.magnet_already: This machine already has a Magnet.
